verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that a My DOR online account exists and that secure.dor.wa.gov sits behind a login wall. Nothing documents how sign-in works: no credential MFA method is described, and nothing rules out biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a mailed PIN. Account creation and the login shell are adjacent facts and do not establish that an authorized human can complete MFA remotely.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
